source: 【G.A Design】上海虹桥丽思卡尔顿酒店丨50%概念设计方案PPT(含JPG平面及设计手稿)丨127页丨101M丨.05.12.pptx

texts.text: The Ritz Carlton, a name with significance
Creating a unique and memorable experience, a legacy of service  that transcends generations
创造独一无二，留存于记忆深处的体验，打造出代代传承的永恒服务体验
Layered detail: interior architecture, art,  lighting, colour, material, texture and technology
层叠的细部：室内，建筑，艺术，光，颜色，材质，质感与科技
Classic design elements filtered through  a contemporary lens
通过现代的镜头审视传统的设计元素
Introducing residential touches to create a reference to the  historical Villas in Hongqiao
引入住宅的手法来创造具有历史沉淀意义的虹桥别墅
强烈有特征的室内空间
Hongqiao – A gateway into the rest of the world
In the past, there was a significant  influence from the West.
In the present, Shanghai reaches out  to the rest of the world.
Historically, this area was one of  Shanghai’s garden suburbs.
过去，它对于西方国家有种重要的作用
现在，它作为上海的交通枢纽，通往世界各地 历史长河的沉淀中，这块区域是上海的郊野花园
Combining urban location with resort elements to create a  strong product for both the business and leisure markets
结合城市的地理位置以及度假酒店的元素打造一个强有力的可以满足商业以及休闲市场的产品
Introducing a strong reference to the garden throughout  the key hotel areas
“花园”的概念作为强有力的设计参考贯穿整个酒店区域
从传统四合院布局作为灵感
从传统四合院布局作为灵感
A series of connecting courtyards respecting the principles of traditional  Chinese architecture
一系列的几进庭院是从尊重传统中式庭院而来
The opportunity to create a contemporary hidden courtyard garden
创造当代隐蔽庭院的契机
Moon gate portals and spirit screens defining areas and  creating a sense of discovery
利用月门和屏风的界定来创造发现空间层次性
Fine art pieces curated to inspire and delight
灵感和愉悦的激发而创造出精心的艺术品
Contemporary installation to become part of the interior
现代装置艺术为室内的一部分
Creating individual pavilions within the public areas  with the use of overlapping screens
利用重叠屏风在公共区域内创建单独的亭台
Central sculptural table with seasonal botanical display,  bronze screens filtering light and vistas beyond, monumental sculpture
四季植艺于正中富有雕塑感的圆桌上展示;透过青铜屏风光影朦胧，远景隐现，标志性大型雕塑呼之欲出
Reception  前台 Concierge 礼宾台
Within a timber pavilion dressed with contemporary ink pots a leather top table with marble  scrolls sits below a suspended installation of over scaled calligraphers’ brushes.
在摆放着现代艺术墨水瓶的木亭之中，悬挂着大型书法家毛笔，装置之下的皮革面书桌装载着优雅厚重的大理石卷轴
Reception  前台 Concierge 礼宾台
Within a second screened pavilion the Gallery houses a curated art collection of  sculpture and ceramics
Elegant service of Afternoon Tea in the sunlit Lounge.
Beyond the screens of the central court lies the elegant and characterful  Lounge Bar. The bespoke cocktail trolley service create a unique experience
Reception  前台 Concierge 礼宾台
In the Hidden Garden a huge stone sculpture sits atop a still reflective pool.
Filtered natural light and abundant planting create a place of calm within the city.
Reception  前台 Concierge 礼宾台
An immersive botanical experience with elegant staging for botanical  display and interaction with florists
在优雅的展台布置中展示植物，与花店气氛呼应结合，进行一场身临其境的沉浸式植物体验
Refined finishes and delicate forms create a natural connection between  Florist and Ballroom
餐饮及小型 活动承办
An express counter for takeaway artisan teas, coffees, patisserie and ice cream.
手工茶、咖啡、糕点和冰淇淋的外卖即取柜台；当代品牌及标志性包装
茶点台 Lounge  休息餐厅
餐饮及小型 活动承办
Inspired by the language of Flemish brasseries figured marble & burnished brass  combine with contemporary bentwood furniture
受佛兰德啤酒屋的语言启发，将大理石和抛光的黄铜与当代曲木家具结合在一起

A marble counter with integrated chilled patisserie display and marble detailing to  feature wall of artisan bread
配有冷藏法式蛋糕展示架和细节的大理石柜台以及特色的工匠面包墙
Displays of fresh produce and preserves are key to the fork to table ethos of the  kitchen and allow for a relaxed open pantry style breakfast service.
确保食材从源头到餐桌的新鲜度是开放式厨房的精神，为客人提供轻松的开放式厨房的早餐服务。
All Day Dining – Open Kitchen and Larder
全日制餐厅-开放厨房&食材展示区
烘焙区/开放厨房&食材展示区
开放厨房及食材展示区
开放厨房及食材展示区
连接门通往大型开放式
The zinc and marble countertops are designed with a lip profile for  seafood preparation and display.
海鲜操作展示台应用了锌和大理石的台面围边设计

Open marble brickwork to the double height wall provide a textured  backdrop to the elegantly minimalist escalator. Intense cinnabar lacquer  doors create dramatic entrances to the ballroom.
开放式大理石砖砌至双倍高度的墙壁为优雅简约的自动扶梯提供了带纹理的背景。 色彩强烈的朱砂漆门为宴会厅营造出戏剧性的入口。
Fragmented marble bricks  with integral lighting
Fragmented marble bricks  with integral lighting
Expressing the natural beauty of the bamboo structure, horizontal bronze  inlay and white on white embossing/relief
呈现竹子结构的自然之美，横向青铜镶嵌出竹节，配以白色浮雕
Gym with direct  access from Lift Lobby
The irregular nature of the narrow alleys is echoed in the language of  the treatment room corridors
狭窄巷弄的不规则性可以做为按摩室走廊的设计灵感
The screens of vertical fins  evoke the spirit of cascading  water, a series of waterfalls.
竖棱屏风唤起瀑布及流水的精神
Glass pop out windows create  viewing platforms to the atrium  inspired by secret views through  a curtain of water.
玻璃凸窗在中庭营造出观景台，其灵感源于透过水 幕的神秘目光。
Inspired by Chinese courtyard  houses the auspicious form is used  to create windows within the brass  screens. Incorporating the garden  narrative into the screens with  modern elegance.
The stylised motif becomes an  iconic image synonymous with the  hotel.
受中国四合院风格房屋的启发，将吉祥的纹样用于 黄铜屏风中打造窗口，让花园的概念融入现代优雅 的帷幕里。
风格化的主题成为酒店的标志性形象。
Creating a haven within the city environment
在城市的氛围中创造一个天堂
‘Hidden Garden’ details to follow through the guestrooms
“隐形花园”的细部概念将贯穿整个客房空间
Open portals create the opportunity to bath in moonlight
沐浴在敞开天的井月光之下
